paper_title: The ORGAN Experiment: An axion haloscope above 15 GHz
notes: Pathfinding run sets g_agamma limit of 2.02e-12 GeV^-1 at 26.531 GHz (110 ueV), over a narrow span of 2.5 neV shaped by Lorentzian resonance. Abstract writes 'eV^-1' but exclusion plot (fig 3) y-axis is GeV^-1 and value matches ~50x KSVZ, confirming GeV^-1. Limit is very narrow around 110 ueV; encoded as short horizontal band spanning approx 100-110 ueV region shown in plot. DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 mentioned for projections.
